discovery.reviewer: Root (Claude Code), source review of the archived turn-4 site: routes, look registry, look switch, URL handling, story beats and ordinary navigation
discovery.scope: The two registered looks of the single story route, Aluminium (light, default) and Anodized (dark), selected by the story-bar switch, which rewrites ?look= in place. The final reply advertises exactly these two at /?look=light and /?look=dark. The spine has seven beats over Prepare, Access and Record; the opening, middle and ending rests are the first beat of each, as the storyboard's spine names them. The concept archive at /concepts and the old sketches are ordinary links, not look alternatives.

eligibility.rationale: The archive holds the authored nested site with two registered looks, a real look switch and the custom fixture geometry. This is eligibility for measurement, not a technical, visual or look pass.

evidence.sourceBasis: post-closure archive of all 205 authored files; the original turn-4 result failed capture and stays complete false
evidence.validation: Selectors, names and beat ids are read from the archived source; no scratch build or browser probe was made before this unit.

alternatives.meaning: Aluminium: warm off-white ground, graphite ink, copper accent and light matte aluminium segments; the agent's recommendation. The trial starts in Anodized so the switch has to change something.
Anodized: deep blue-grey ground, ivory ink, pale teal accent and dark anodized segments. The trial starts in the default Aluminium.

ordinaryControls.purpose: Story, Mosslink, CV and Email navigation
concept archive, not a look alternative
in-story shortcuts, CV, contact and project links

limits: Source declarations and actor claims do not establish legibility, material difference or meaningful spatial explanation.
Ordinary links, the Mosslink page, CV, icon, preview and 404 are inventoried but not exercised by the look worker; they belong to the final whole-site check.
